scope: Matched public compiler facades and matched finite arithmetic/control scenarios only; unmatched rows retain null rather than an unlike denominator.
metric_boundary: No check-time or transitive lemma-count measurement. Facade LOC is statement plus proof code, unlike the superseded header-only ratios. Finite-case counts compare selected operation scenarios, not language coverage or proof strength.

conclusion: The small checked compiler facade is an outlier against the CakeML facade because compact Input/Agrees contracts hide detail that the reference facade exposes; both sides delegate. Other measured facade and finite-case ratios are within 3x. Semantic compiler weaknesses are assessed from permitted behaviours, not inferred from these sizes.
